decisions.reason: The cleaning soap complements the core flooring range, supports aftercare revenues and customer loyalty, and fits the firm's strategy of offering complete wood-floor systems.
The maintenance oil extends the established care portfolio for wooden floors and is a natural recurring accessory product for the firm's installed base.
A dedicated care product for oiled wood floors serves a clear technical need within the firm's main category and strengthens its full-service offer to trade and end customers.
The moisture-protection underlay is a practical add-on for floor installation, increases system compatibility, and supports cross-selling with the firm's flooring products.
High-density underlay foam broadens the installation accessories range and is well aligned with the firm's positioning around performance, guidance, and complete flooring solutions.
The oak parquet floor is close to the firm's core business, matches ongoing demand for durable and attractive wood floors, and directly supports growth in its main product segment.
